title: Would you use an AI assistant for TradingView Pine Script?
author: Jealous_Win2699
selftext:
I've been wondering how useful an AI assistant for TradingView actually is.

Imagine being able to write:

"Create a strategy using a 50/200 EMA crossover, RSI confirmation and an ATR-based stop loss."

and get a Pine Script draft that you can immediately open in TradingView.

I found a tool that does something along these lines:

[https://tradingviewai.dev/](https://tradingviewai.dev/)

I'm curious what experienced TradingView users think.

Would you actually use something like this, or do you prefer writing Pine Script manually?
